findings.quoted_text: Contractor will accommodate reasonable changes to scope requested by Client within the overall project budget. Changes that would exceed that budget are documented in a written change request.
The parties intend to allow 15 rounds of ordinary revisions for the principal creative Deliverables. Additional revisions may require a written change order.
Contractor will accommodate reasonable changes to scope requested by Client within the overall project budget. Changes that would exceed that budget are documented in a written change request.
findings.explanation: You are required to accommodate scope changes without extra pay as long as they fit within the overall project budget.
findings.suggested_change: Any changes or additions to the scope of work shall be agreed upon in writing by both parties and billed at the Contractor's standard rates.

findings.quoted_text: The parties intend to allow 15 rounds of ordinary revisions for the principal creative Deliverables. Additional revisions may require a written change order.
findings.explanation: The contract permits up to 15 rounds of revisions, which is an excessive amount of revision work.
findings.suggested_change: The parties agree to include up to two rounds of revisions for the principal creative Deliverables. Additional revisions shall be charged at the Contractor's standard hourly rate.

findings.explanation: Payment terms of Net 60 significantly delay your receipt of funds, creating cash flow risks.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, Thank you for sharing the agreement. I have reviewed the text and would like to propose a few adjustments before we move forward. - Regarding the relevant clause on scope changes, the current terms require accommodating changes within the existing budget without additional pay; I propose that any changes or additions to the scope of work shall be agreed upon in writing by both parties and billed at the Contractor's standard rates. - Regarding the relevant clause on revision rounds, the agreement permits up to 15 rounds of revisions, which creates an excessive amount of revision work; I propose that the parties agree to include up to two rounds of revisions for the principal creative Deliverables, with additional revisions charged at the Contractor's standard hourly rate. - Regarding the relevant clause on payment terms, Net 60 significantly delays the receipt of funds and creates cash flow risks; I propose that invoices are payable Net 30. Thank you for your understanding, and I look forward to finalizing this.
